messages:
oliver: heads up — AcmeCorp flagged a ~20% surge on their invoice vs dashboard during month close, looks like tokens doubled for one plan line. can anyone look? :wave:

maya: account id? invoice #?

oliver: acct=acme_8743, invoice=INV-2026-03-ACM-8743. dashboard shows 1.2M tokens, invoice lists 2.4M tokens. noticed it at reconciliation. no plan change on their side.

kevin (eng): ok can you grab a quick CSV export of usage window around cutoff? want to check duplicate writes + ingestion window overlap. SQL I usually run:```sql
SELECT customer_id, event_time, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme_8743'
  AND event_time >= '2026-02-28 23:50:00'
  AND event_time <= '2026-03-01 00:10:00'
GROUP BY customer_id, event_time
ORDER BY event_time;```

oliver: dumping now to s3://redwood-temp/acme_8743/march-close.csv

billing-bot: automated alert — invoice generation run completed (job id 8765). Cutoff snapshot ts=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z.

luis (eng-infra): quick thought — last month we had the embed-backfill job retry loop that was noisy. if retries wrote events with same ingestion_id but different event_time we could double-count at billing rollup. can kevin grep for duplicate ingestion_id? :eyes:

kevin (eng): running duplicate check on the CSV. snippet I ran:```bash
cat march-close.csv | sort | uniq -d -c | head -n 20
# or SQL: SELECT ingestion_id, count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE customer_id='acme_8743' AND event_time BETWEEN ... GROUP BY ingestion_id HAVING count(*)>1;```

kevin (eng): result — found 1,024 rows with same ingestion_id duplicated, each ~1,100 tokens. duplicates mostly between 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-01T00:00:06Z (within retry window).

oliver: so that explains the ~1.1M extra tokens. how did retries get past dedupe?

luis (eng-infra): looks like the dedupe TTL for our ingestion cache expired at ~00:00:03Z because the cluster restarted briefly during the cutoff, so second writes missed cache hit. engineered race. i'm creating a follow-up ticket to extend TTL and add an idempotency layer.

anita (finance): ok from billing side — customer disputed. do we want to issue a provisional credit while infra fixes?

maya: customer is escalated and expects a fast resolution. recommend provisional credit for the duplicate tokens and note on invoice.

kevin (eng): to be safe let's compute final duplicate token total: duplicates=1024 * 1100 = 1,126,400 tokens. confirm math and we can apply credit.

anita (finance): confirmed. we'll apply a credit line for 1,126,400 tokens on INV-2026-03-ACM-8743 and add a note: "provisional credit for duplicate ingestion during month-close; permanent adjustments pending infra remediation."

oliver: communicated to customer, they acknowledged and asked for timeline on fix.

luis (eng-infra): timeline: patch to extend TTL + idempotency check will be deployed tomorrow 10:00 UTC; will run a replay test and backfill dedupe job to scrub duplicates from raw_events.

anita (finance): please post back when the backfill completes so we can finalize the credit or reverse if needed. also export the audit CSV for compliance.

kevin (eng): will attach repro steps and SQL used in ticket. repro notes: reproduce by pushing same ingestion_id twice within 10s while controller restarts — observed double-count when cache eviction coincides with restart.

maya: thanks all. customer happy with provisional credit. follow-up task assigned to eng-infra/ticket #INF-4621. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: ticket INF-4621 created and linked to INV-2026-03-ACM-8743."
